parameters.query:
WITH matched AS (
  SELECT token, event_id, zoom_meeting_id, zoom_join_url, kind
    FROM coexistence.ia360_meeting_links
   WHERE ($1::text <> '' AND event_id = $1)
      OR ($2::text <> '' AND zoom_meeting_id::text = $2)
   LIMIT 1
),
to_delete AS (
  DELETE FROM coexistence.ia360_meeting_links m
   USING matched
   WHERE m.token = matched.token
     AND (
       ($3::boolean AND $4::boolean)
       OR ($3::boolean AND (matched.zoom_meeting_id IS NULL AND matched.zoom_join_url IS NULL))
       OR ($4::boolean AND (matched.event_id IS NULL OR matched.event_id = ''))
     )
   RETURNING m.token, m.event_id, m.zoom_meeting_id, 'deleted' AS op
),
to_update AS (
  UPDATE coexistence.ia360_meeting_links m
     SET event_id = CASE WHEN $3::boolean THEN NULL ELSE m.event_id END,
         zoom_meeting_id = CASE WHEN $4::boolean THEN NULL ELSE m.zoom_meeting_id END,
         zoom_join_url = CASE WHEN $4::boolean THEN NULL ELSE m.zoom_join_url END,
         kind = CASE WHEN $3::boolean THEN 'zoom' WHEN $4::boolean THEN 'cal' ELSE m.kind END
    FROM matched
   WHERE m.token = matched.token
     AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM to_delete)
   RETURNING m.token, m.event_id, m.zoom_meeting_id, 'updated' AS op
)
SELECT * FROM to_delete
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM to_update;
